name: Domain vs Prefect Operational Identity Namespaces
description: Separation of domain and Prefect operational identity namespaces: domainNamespace (PipelineInvocationIdentity, StageIdentity, StepIdentity, SPUIdentity, ...) vs prefactNamespace (PipelineFlowRunId, StageFlowRunId, StepFlowRunId, SPUTaskRunId, ...); neither namespace substitutes for the other.
